_comment: xAI Responses on the API-key and SuperGrok Connections (no live verification in this checkout; the shapes keep the pre-profile wire). Optional parameters are limited to the xAI set and, when the catalog lists supported parameters, to those it lists (max_tokens counts as listed with max_output_tokens). Effort none asks a Model without a none rung for its lowest rung, because those Models cannot disable reasoning. Only JPEG and PNG images are carried.

grok-4.3.note: Grok 4.3 lists a none rung; the wire has always omitted reasoning for effort none. Kept until verified live.
